mapper.sql: select i.id, i.item_type, i.title, i.summary, i.content, i.parent_id, i.category_id, i.cover_url, i.file_url, i.thumbnail_url, i.resource_type, i.processing_status, i.processing_message, i.related_exam_id, i.related_paper_id, i.user_id, u.user_name, i.answer_content, i.status, i.sort_order, i.duration_minutes, i.credit, i.score, i.start_time, i.finish_time, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark, (select count(1) from exam_training_item p where p.parent_id = i.id and p.item_type = 'progress') as learner_count, (select count(1) from exam_training_item p where p.parent_id = i.id and p.item_type = 'progress' and p.status = 'completed') as completed_count, (select count(1) from exam_training_item r where r.parent_id = i.id and r.item_type in ('lesson','resource','media_resource')) as resource_count from exam_training_item i left join sys_user u on u.user_id = i.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into exam_training_item( item_type, title, summary, content, parent_id, category_id, cover_url, file_url, thumbnail_url, resource_type, processing_status, processing_message, related_exam_id, related_paper_id, user_id, answer_content, status, sort_order, duration_minutes, credit, score, start_time, finish_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{itemType}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{categoryId}, #{coverUrl}, #{fileUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{resourceType}, #{processingStatus}, #{processingMessage}, #{relatedExamId}, #{relatedPaperId}, #{userId}, #{answerContent}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{durationMinutes}, #{credit}, #{score}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update exam_training_item set processing_status = #{processingStatus}, processing_message = #{processingMessage}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select sum(case when item_type = 'course' then 1 else 0 end) as course_count, sum(case when item_type in ('lesson','resource','media_resource') then 1 else 0 end) as resource_count, sum(case when item_type = 'qa' then 1 else 0 end) as qa_count, sum(case when item_type = 'certificate' then 1 else 0 end) as certificate_count, (select count(1) from exam_training_attachment where status = '0') as attachment_count, sum(case when item_type = 'practice' then 1 else 0 end) as practice_count, sum(case when status = 'published' then 1 else 0 end) as published_count, sum(case when status = 'completed' then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, sum(case when item_type = 'qa' and status = 'open' then 1 else 0 end) as open_qa_count, sum(case when item_type = 'media_resource' and processing_status = 'ready' then 1 else 0 end) as media_ready_count, sum(case when item_type = 'media_resource' and processing_status = 'skipped' then 1 else 0 end) as media_skipped_count, sum(case when item_type = 'media_resource' and processing_status = 'failed' then 1 else 0 end) as media_failed_count, coalesce(sum(case when item_type in ('progress','credit','practice') and status = 'completed' then credit when item_type = 'certificate' and status = 'issued' then credit else 0 end), 0) as total_credit, avg(case when item_type in ('practice','progress') and score is not null then score else null end) as average_score from exam_training_item

select id, title from exam_training_item where item_type = 'course'
and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by sort_order asc, create_time desc, id desc limit 50

select id, exam_name as examName, status, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime from exam_examination where status in ('1', '2')
and (exam_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(id as char) = #{keyword})
order by create_time desc, id desc limit 50

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(u.user_id as char) = #{keyword})
order by u.user_id asc limit 50
